scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run server" "npm run web"
scripts.dev:legacy: npx concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.dev:web: npx concurrently "npm run server" "npm run web"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
